lesson:
Think Backwards 💡◀️

Deepinder Goyal - Zomato Founder

For example na channel ki 1 Lakh Subscribers ravali anukondi.. then akkada nunchi backward think cheyyali. 1 Lakh Subscribers ravali ante first chala views kavali. 100 views ki oka subscriber osthunnadu anukondi.. then 10 Million Views kavali 1 Lakh subs kavali ante. So appudu na target viral videos mida undali. 1 Million views.. or 5 lakh views ala oche laga.. then 1 Lakh subs ochestaru
Zero To One Ideas - Peter Thiel
